item.title: Encord raises €50M to build the data layer for physical AI
item.description: London-based data infrastructure startup Encord has closed a €50 million ($60 million) Series C funding round, led by Wellington Management, with participation from existing backers including Y Combinator, CRV, N47, Crane Venture Partners and Harpoon Ventures, alongside new investors Bright Pixel Capital and Isomer Capital. item.title: OpenAI secures record-breaking $110B funding to “Scale AI for everyone”

item.title: Europe’s Deep-Tech Paradox
item.description: Europe does not suffer from a shortage of capital. item.title: OpenAI signs Pentagon AI deal after Trump orders Anthropic ban
item.description: OpenAI has reached an agreement with the Pentagon to deploy its artificial intelligence models in classified military systems, just hours after President Donald Trump ordered federal agencies to stop using rival Anthropic’s technology.
